import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Arc {
        int s, d;
        double w;
        Arc(int u, int v, double cap) {
            s = u;
            d = v;
            w = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        ArrayList<Integer> adj = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static class MaxFlowGraph {
        ArrayList<Node> V;
        ArrayList<Arc> E;

        MaxFlowGraph(int nodes, int edges_cap) {
            V = new ArrayList<>(nodes);
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) {
                V.add(new Node());
            }
            E = new ArrayList<>(edges_cap);
        }

        void link(int u, int v, double cap) {
            E.add(new Arc(u, v, cap));
            V.get(u).adj.add(E.size() - 1);
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> dfs_path(int src, int dst, double[] f, double[] bneck) {
            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Double.compare(b[0], a[0]));
            double[] dist = new double[V.size()];
            int[] prev_edge = new int[V.size()];
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0.0);
            Arrays.fill(prev_edge, -1);

            dist[src] = Double.MAX_VALUE;
            pq.offer(new int[]{(int) dist[src], src});

            while (!pq.isEmpty() && dist[dst] == 0.0) {
                int[] top = pq.poll();
                double cap = top[0];
                int node = top[1];

                for (int idx : V.get(node).adj) {
                    Arc a = E.get(idx);
                    double res = a.w - f[idx];
                    if (res > 0) {
                        double nc = Math.min(cap, res);
                        if (nc > dist[a.d]) {
                            dist[a.d] = nc;
                            pq.offer(new int[]{(int) dist[a.d], a.d});
                            prev_edge[a.d] = idx;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            bneck[0] = dist[dst];
            ArrayList<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int e = prev_edge[dst]; e != -1; e = prev_edge[E.get(e).s]) {
                path.add(e);
            }
            return path;
        }

        double compute_flow(int s, int t) {
            MaxFlowGraph residual = new MaxFlowGraph(V.size(), E.size() * 2);
            double[] flow = new double[E.size() * 2];

            for (int i = 0; i < E.size(); i++) {
                residual.link(E.get(i).s, E.get(i).d, E.get(i).w);
                residual.link(E.get(i).d, E.get(i).s, 0.0);
            }

            double total = 0.0;
            double[] cap = new double[1];
            ArrayList<Integer> path = residual.dfs_path(s, t, flow, cap);
            while (!path.isEmpty() && cap[0] > 0) {
                for (int e : path) {
                    int rev = (e % 2) != 0 ? e - 1 : e + 1;
                    flow[e] += cap[0];
                    flow[rev] -= cap[0];
                }
                total += cap[0];
                path = residual.dfs_path(s, t, flow, cap);
            }

            for (int idx : residual.V.get(s).adj) {
                total += flow[idx];
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int n, T;
    static class Cell {
        int r, c;
        boolean[] sick = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int people = 0, pods = 0;

        Cell() {
            people = 0;
            pods = 0;
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        }

        int vertex_id(int t) {
            return 2 + r + n * c + n * n * t;
        }

        void block() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void infect(int t) {
            if (accessible[t]) {
                accessible[t] = false;
                sick[t] = true;
            }
        }

        void spread(int t) {
            if (sick[t]) {
                infect(t + 1);
                if (r > 0) world[r-1][c].infect(t + 1);
                if (r < n - 1) world[r+1][c].infect(t + 1);
                if (c > 0) world[r][c-1].infect(t + 1);
                if (c < n - 1) world[r][c+1].infect(t + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static Cell[][] world = new Cell[10][10];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            world[i] = new Cell[10];
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                world[i][j] = new Cell();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                world[i][j].r = i;
                world[i][j].c = j;
                if (line.charAt(j) == 'Y') {
                    world[i][j].block();
                } else if (line.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    world[i][j].infect(0);
                } else {
                    world[i][j].people = line.charAt(j) - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (line.charAt(j) != 'Y' && line.charAt(j) != 'Z') {
                    world[i][j].pods = line.charAt(j) - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int step = 0; step <= T; step++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (step < T) {
                        world[i][j].spread(step);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        MaxFlowGraph g = new MaxFlowGraph(n * n * (T + 1) + 2, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Cell cell = world[i][j];
                if (cell.people > 0) {
                    g.link(0, cell.vertex_id(0), cell.people);
                }
                if (cell.pods > 0) {
                    g.link(cell.vertex_id(T), 1, cell.pods);
                }
                for (int step = 0; step < T; step++) {
                    if (cell.pods > 0) {
                        g.link(cell.vertex_id(step), cell.vertex_id(T), 1000);
                    }
                    if (cell.accessible[step]) {
                        if (i > 0 && world[i-1][j].accessible[step]) {
                            g.link(cell.vertex_id(step), world[i-1][j].vertex_id(step + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (i < n - 1 && world[i+1][j].accessible[step]) {
                            g.link(cell.vertex_id(step), world[i+1][j].vertex_id(step + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j > 0 && world[i][j-1].accessible[step]) {
                            g.link(cell.vertex_id(step), world[i][j-1].vertex_id(step + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j < n - 1 && world[i][j+1].accessible[step]) {
                            g.link(cell.vertex_id(step), world[i][j+1].vertex_id(step + 1), 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int) g.compute_flow(0, 1));
    }
}
